newsitem.title: UK: EUROPEAN VGO PRICES EASE ON LOWER US MOGAS.
newsitem.headline: EUROPEAN VGO PRICES EASE ON LOWER US MOGAS.

text.p: European vacuum gas oil prices softened a little by the end of the week, mainly on the back of falling U.S. gasoline futures, traders said.
Traders assessed the level of low sulphur VGO cargoes in the $136 fob area, some $2 lower than by mid-week, after gasoline futures fell in the United States on Thursday night.
"With Mogas collapsing, VGO prices are lower," said a trader, adding he was offered a small parcel of Russian high sulphur VGO on the water at $125 cif.
"With U.S. prices lower, trans-Atlantic trade opportunities will not work until VGO prices come down," he added.
